decisions.decision: Implemented a minimal dry-run JSON parser instead of integrating Newtonsoft.Json.Schema to avoid adding new package/dependency in this commit.
decisions.rationale: Keep scope minimal; full schema validation can be added in follow-up where license and package management are considered.

decisions.decision: Recorded review findings in review-report.md and adjusted changes-log to remove self-reference.
decisions.rationale: Improve clarity of changes-log and capture review activity.

decisions.decision: Created Editor test file Assets/Tests/Editor/EditorTools/JsonImportValidatorTests_Extended.cs to validate file parsing and dry-run logic.
decisions.rationale: JsonImportValidator is an EditorWindow and tests belong under Assets/Tests/Editor; created an _Extended test file to follow project conventions and avoid task-scoped test folders.

tests.summary: No tests executed during this implementation; recommended follow-up: add unit tests for JSON->ScriptableObject conversion.
